source_text: Bramblin makes its Pokemon GO debut during Fall Marathon: Buddy Trek! Explore up to 42 km to earn Marathon Visor Pikachu, enjoy increased chances of encountering Shiny Electrike and Shiny Hisuian Growlithe, and unlock new GO Pass rewards. The event runs from Tuesday, October 13, at 10:00 a.m. to Monday, October 19, 2026, at 8:00 p.m. local time .
